# AGENTS.md — IsaFlow

> AI coding assistant context for OpenAI Codex CLI, Devin, and other tool compatibility. Mirrors the canonical `CLAUDE.md`.

## Project Overview

Next.js 14 + TypeScript multi-tenant accounting SaaS for South African businesses. Every DB query is scoped by `company_id`. Deployed to `app.isaflow.co.za`.

- **Stack**: Next.js 14 (Pages Router) · TypeScript strict · React 19 · Tailwind · Vitest 4 · Playwright
- **DB**: Postgres on self-hosted Supabase (Velocity server). The legacy `@/lib/neon` import path is preserved but the runtime is pg-backed, not Neon Serverless.
- **Auth**: GoTrue (Supabase Auth). `withAuth` middleware sets user + company + transaction GUCs.
- **Package manager**: `bun@1.3.2` (pinned via `packageManager` field).
- **Node**: `>=20.12.0` (Vitest 4/Rolldown imports `node:util` `styleText`, unavailable below).

## Project Structure

```
src/
├── modules/
│   ├── accounting/   # Core: AR, AP, banking, GL, reporting, assets, VAT, payroll, AFS
│   ├── admin/        # Platform admin: companies, users, billing, plans, feature flags
│   ├── analytics/    # Tracking + query
│   ├── auth/         # GoTrue MFA, session management
│   ├── billing/      # PAYG Flow wallet, Stitch Express, subscription billing
│   ├── bureau/       # Bureau-mode payroll
│   └── onboarding/   # SA address + CIPC reg-number normalisers (pure)
├── lib/              # Shared utilities (neon, logger, apiResponse, auth)
└── components/       # Shared UI (AppLayout, accountingNavConfig)
pages/
├── api/              # API routes (Next.js Pages API)
└── accounting/       # UI pages
scripts/migrations/sql/  # 260+ SQL migrations (latest: 478)
tests/{unit,e2e}/    # Vitest unit + Playwright E2E
```

**Module-level docs**: 49 sibling `.claude.md` / `AGENTS.md` files exist next to each module and API-route group. Codex/Devin walk the tree and compose them with this root file.

## Setup Commands

```bash
nvm use              # Pin to Node 20.12.0 from .nvmrc
bun install          # Install deps with bun (pinned 1.3.2)
bun run dev          # Start dev server on :3200
bun run build        # Production build
bun run lint         # ESLint (with --report-unused-disable-directives)
bun run type-check   # tsc --noEmit
bun run test:unit    # Vitest unit tests (after check-runtime + check-routes)
bun run ci           # Full CI gate (scripts/ci/run-ci.sh)
bun run db:migrate   # Apply pending Supabase migrations
bash scripts/deploy.sh  # Deploy
```

## Code Style

### Critical Rules (ALL code, ALL agents)

- **Branch first**: Parallel agents run on this repo. NEVER edit on `master`. First action of any code-editing task is `git checkout -b <name>`.
- **No stubs**: When a deploy/CI gate fails on a missing module, build the real thing. Never commit `return null` / TODO placeholders to satisfy a typecheck.
- **Multi-tenant**: ALWAYS add `company_id` to every DB query. Never return data across tenants.
- **DB**: Use `sql` tagged template from `@/lib/neon` (legacy path; runtime is Supabase/pg). NEVER string concatenation.
- **API handlers**: Wrap with `withAuth(withErrorHandler(handler as any))` (re-exported from `@/lib/auth`). Legacy `withCompany` is gone post-GoTrue cutover.
- **Responses**: Use `apiResponse.success()` / `.badRequest()` / `.notFound()` from `@/lib/apiResponse`.
- **Logging**: Use `log` from `@/lib/logger` — NEVER `console.log`.
- **Error handling**: No empty `catch` blocks.
- **Types**: 100% TypeScript coverage. No `any` except where required by Next.js patterns.
- **File size**: Max 300 lines per file.
- **Dates**: pg returns `Date` objects from timestamp columns — handle both `Date` and `string` shapes.
- **Customer invoices**: Use `COALESCE(ci.client_id, ci.customer_id)` — both columns exist (legacy migration artefact).
- **Nav**: Update `src/components/accounting/accountingNavConfig.ts` for every new page.
- **Migrations**: `IF NOT EXISTS` on all `CREATE TABLE` / `CREATE INDEX`. Use the next unused 3-digit prefix; never reuse. Use `244b_` style suffix if inserting between existing numbers.

### Key Paths

| What | Where |
|------|-------|
| DB client | `src/lib/neon.ts` |
| API response helpers | `src/lib/apiResponse.ts` |
| Logger | `src/lib/logger.ts` |
| Auth middleware | `src/lib/auth/index.ts` (re-exports `withAuth`, `withRole`, `withUserAuth`) |
| Services | `src/modules/accounting/services/` |
| API routes | `pages/api/accounting/` |
| UI pages | `pages/accounting/` |
| Migrations | `scripts/migrations/sql/` |
| Nav config | `src/components/accounting/accountingNavConfig.ts` |
| Unit tests | `tests/unit/` |
| E2E tests | `tests/e2e/` |

## Testing Guidelines

- **Unit**: Vitest in `tests/unit/services/`. Run `bun run test:unit`.
- **E2E**: Playwright in `tests/e2e/`. Run `bun run test:e2e`.
- **TDD enforced**: tests FIRST, implementation second.
- **CI gate**: `bun run ci` runs lint + type-check + unit + migration-naming check. Required before any PR.

## Development Workflow

### Git
- Always create a working branch first (`git checkout -b <name>`); never edit on `master`.
- Parallel sessions run on this repo — branch isolation prevents commits from sweeping each other's unstaged files.
- No `--no-verify`, no force-push to `master`, no amending published commits.

### Deployment
- Deploys to `app.isaflow.co.za` via `bash scripts/deploy.sh`.
- The deploy script enforces lint ratchet baselines and the migration-naming gate.
- Production deploys are blocked during business hours (08:00–17:00 SAST, Mon–Fri) without explicit approval.

### Module docs
Add a sibling `.claude.md` (and corresponding `AGENTS.md` mirror) when introducing a new module with ≥4 files. Pattern: Purpose / Caller contract / Main signatures / Business rules / Recent changes.
